title: Publish is one step wizard: ZIP export asks for the emailed code before Download, and Sync from live reports its states in words
steps: S1: run packages/core/tracy-core/test/publish-sync-zip-dom.test.mjs (DOM render of the wizard steps with stub doors).
expect: S1: ZIP goes Prepare, Send code, then Download only once six digits are typed, then Downloaded; Sync never synced offers Sync now; a failed sync gives the reason in words, the support code and Try again; a Sync from live started from the menu starts no export.
fence: Wizard states are read from the rendered DOM with stubbed doors

tests: ZIP: Prepare, Send code, then Download only once six digits are typed, and Downloaded
Sync, never synced: says so, and the footer button is Sync now
Sync, failed: the reason in words, the code for support, and Try again
Sync from live (menu): the sync is applied and said on the Sync step; no export is started
